immediate_order: Finish current v1 all3 and all7 comparison plus queued conditional sequence uncertainty
Same-public-initialization distance0 single-factor experiment after real two-step preflight

literature_status: User-supplied PCT/MPT/MIR/SRFT/GEM/CPO/RoIAlign/DAgger pointers are design references; no new independent literature verification or result claim made here.

design.mainline: Preserve reliable target-localization abilities, retain beneficial learning, and prevent small changes from amplifying through predicted-box search-state feedback.

module_1.name: Target-level capability preservation and bounded risk memory
risks: Per-sample step damage relative to the immediately preceding model
Reliability-weighted preservation damage relative to the fixed public reference
module_1.reliability: Use training ground truth to establish reference reliability; confidence alone is insufficient and erroneous reference predictions must not be blindly copied.
module_1.reference_outputs: Reference and candidate outputs must correspond to exactly the same crop, geometric augmentation and input preprocessing.
module_1.memory: Random coverage plus bounded training-only records of fragile sequence/frame/crop/augmentation states; never add test videos to update checks.

module_2.name: Risk-constrained task-adaptive actual updates that preserve beneficial learning
module_2.immediate_experiment: Distance0 only: remove the0.05 candidate distance penalty and retain the bounded correction, initialization, seed, data, budget and all other algorithm settings.
module_2.later_experiment: Compare bounded Gram correction with a slack inequality-constrained correction in the eligible actual-displacement subspace; use real forward acceptance, no global no-regression or Pareto guarantee.
module_2.feasible_candidate_selection: Among risk-feasible candidates, measure retained objective improvement; correction frequency and zero-update frequency are not success measures.
module_2.routing: Allow useful Top-k changes; diagnose content-only, router-only and combined updates on fixed training clips before attributing harm to routing.
module_2.eligible_scope: Current risk-eligible parameters2277888 of5821440 trainable, about39.13%; record violated targets, residual harm and bound saturation before considering minimal active-expert expansion.

module_3.name: Search-state-sensitive closed-loop acceptance with independent decisions
module_3.trajectory_only_candidates: A trajectory-only risk must be able to generate or select an alternative actual update; existing alpha0 still applies the full adaptive update and is not a rejected or zero update.
module_3.learning_accounting: Record preserved learning, backtracking, update rejection and additional forward cost; a zero-update candidate alone is not a solution.
module_3.crop_attribution: Fixed training clips: before-parameters/before-crop, after-parameters/before-crop, before-parameters/after-crop, after-parameters/after-crop. Keep original images, template, preprocessing and evaluation coordinates fixed; record actual integer crop boundaries and GT errors separately from between-model prediction differences.
module_3.capture_requirement: Use actual available paired model states or capture future paired states; do not claim to replay a historical update without its pre/post parameters.
module_3.primary_route: Training-only neighboring search-state checks near measured crop-boundary sensitivity; use matched RGB/auxiliary geometry and preserve the inference crop pipeline.
module_3.separate_control: Continuous sampling versus integer crop quantization is an attribution control, not optimizer credit.
module_3.clip_expansion: Keep random coverage; add measured training-pool distractor/edge cases, then occlusion/reappearance only with correct visibility handling.

new_diagnostics.capability_preservation: Predeclare training/validation reliability and material-damage thresholds; report both losses of reference-reliable cases and repairs of reference failures alongside complete official scores.
new_diagnostics.closed_loop_amplification: Separate fixed-input parameter effects, induced crop effects and their interaction, integer boundary changes, GT localization errors and actual target-out-of-search events.
new_diagnostics.inference_and_evaluation: No inference-network or crop change in the immediate distance0 experiment; baseline protocols and complete raw results remain fixed.

evidence_boundaries: Test sequence changes do not prove task-mean cancellation in training; record per-sample training damage first.
The observed near-zero denominator floor activation count is0; do not add defensive branches for an unobserved floor failure.
Route-set changes are associated with risk, not established causes, and stable route sets do not guarantee safety.
Existing seven trajectory-only events demonstrate a decision gap; distance0 alone does not repair it.
Saved fixed-pair whole-sequence bootstrap is conditional sampling uncertainty, not training-seed variance or module attribution.

scope: Only the future requirements and single handoff were updated. V1 training/evaluation and distance0 protocol/sources unchanged; no live progress, hardware read/control, model/scorer execution, restart or weight action.
